title: A Laser Caught an 84-Foot Rogue Wave Out of Nowhere

scenes.text: In 1995, a laser measured an 84-foot wave out of nowhere.
It hit an oil platform in the North Sea on New Year's Day.
The waves around it were about 39 feet. This one was more than twice as tall.
Sailors had told stories about monster waves for centuries. Scientists thought they were legends.
That laser reading was the first proof that rogue waves are real.
An 84-foot wall of water, out of nowhere, and the laser caught it.

description:
In 1995 a laser on an oil platform measured an 84-foot rogue wave, the first one ever proven.
The waves around it were only about 39 feet.
Would you sail through a storm?
first_comment: Would you sail through a storm like that?
